purpose: Pins the ONE embedding model the offline curation tooling may use
(plan P4.16 / borrowable B4). The model proposes candidates and flags
sense inversions for HUMAN review; a human approves each with a
rationale, the gauntlet verifies, and only static reviewed anchors
ship. Nothing in curation/ is imported by the artifact build graph or
the engine, and no embedding, similarity score, or model output ever
reaches the shipped artifact (covenant #1: no AI at runtime).

pinned.note: ONNX conversion of the upstream model (same weights, same Apache-2.0 license), runnable offline in Node via @xenova/transformers with no Python and no remote calls.

fetch: npm run fetch-model (downloads the pinned revision, verifies every sha256 above, fails closed on any mismatch)
